metadata.title: SubStreamEdu Microservices Architecture
metadata.description: High-availability Go microservices ecosystem for SubstreamEdu platform with Kafka event bus, Redis caching, and full observability stack.
metadata.author: SubstreamEdu Core Team

groups.label: Edge & Client Layer
groups.description: Public ingress, reverse proxy, and web frontend

groups.label: API Gateway Layer
groups.description: Central routing, JWT verification, and rate limiting

groups.label: Data & Event Bus Layer
groups.description: State persistence, caching, and async messaging

nodes.label: Client / Web Browser
nodes.description: User facing web application for vocabulary learning and media streaming.

nodes.label: Caddy Reverse Proxy
nodes.description: SSL termination, static asset serving for React frontend, and reverse proxying /api to API Gateway.

nodes.label: SubStreamEdu Gateway
nodes.description: Central entry point. Handles request routing, token authentication checks, and Redis rate limiting.

nodes.label: IAM Service
nodes.description: Identity & Access Management. Google OAuth2, JWT generation, user registration & email validation.

nodes.label: Dictionary Service
nodes.description: Core vocabulary service with AI LLM integrations (DeepSeek, Groq, Gemini) and image APIs.

nodes.label: Media Service
nodes.description: Subtitles processing & audio/video integration (YouTube, Spotify, SubDL, DeepSeek).

nodes.label: Notification Service
nodes.description: Async notification processing. Telegram bot integrations, email alerts, and Kafka consumer.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database
nodes.description: Primary relational database storing IAM (sse_iam), Dictionary (substreamedu_dictionary), and Media schemas.

nodes.label: Redis Cache
nodes.description: In-memory cache for API rate limiting, session storage, and dictionary lookup acceleration.

nodes.label: Kafka & Zookeeper
nodes.description: Event bus for asynchronous event processing (e.g. dictionary updates triggering notifications).

nodes.label: Prometheus Metrics
nodes.description: Pulls HTTP actuator metrics and system performance metrics from Gateway and all services.

nodes.label: Grafana & Loki
nodes.description: Centralized visualization dashboards and log aggregation for microservices.

nodes.label: Jaeger Tracing
nodes.description: Distributed request tracing across Gateway and microservice calls.

edges.label: HTTPS / WSS
edges.description: User web traffic and WebSocket connection

edges.label: HTTP /api
edges.description: Proxies API calls to the central Go Gateway

edges.label: Rate Limit & Sessions
edges.description: Checks client request rate limits and token sessions

edges.label: /dictionary-service/*
edges.description: Vocabulary searches, definitions, AI word processing

edges.label: SQL (sse_iam)
edges.description: Persists user profiles, roles, and refresh tokens

edges.label: SQL (substreamedu_dictionary)
edges.description: Stores words, translations, and user vocabulary lists

edges.label: Get/Set Cache
edges.description: Caches AI LLM responses and word definitions

edges.label: Publish Event
edges.description: Publishes word_learned and streak_updated events to Kafka

edges.label: SQL (substreamedu_media)
edges.description: Stores subtitle timestamps and media metadata

edges.label: Consume Event
edges.description: Listens for learning events to trigger Telegram / Email notifications

edges.label: SQL (sse_iam)
edges.description: Reads user notification preferences and Telegram IDs

edges.label: Scrape Metrics
edges.description: Pulls HTTP latency and error rates
